description.text: The master program was authorized in 1991 and is one of the first master programs authorized by the Academic Degree Committee of the State Council. As a key discipline of the Ministry of Information Industry and Chongqing Municipality, it is equipped with a provincial and ministerial key laboratory, a university-level key laboratory and 6 research institutes. It has 12 professors (4 doctoral tutors), 27 associate professors including 15 with a doctoral degree. It offers a doctor program jointly with several famous universities in China such as the University of Electronic Science and Technology, Chongqing University. With a perfect research experimental, it is qualified for a domestic visiting scholar program. In recent years, teachers in the discipline have completed more than 20 projects, including the National Natural Science Foundation project, the state "863" projects and provincial and ministerial scientific and technological projects, several of which have won the Ministry of Science and Technology Progress Award. It has developed a certain scale in researches of "Coding Theory and Technology", " Signal Processing Theory and Technology", "Network Testing Theory and Techniques" , and has made achievements especially in the low-density parity-check code design and applied research, applied research of Gallager code, mobile testing communications. It has a number of papers published in the IEEE Transaction series of publications and national patents, and during the last three years 60 of its papers have been selected by SCI, EI and ISTP retrieval system.

duration.text: The Signal and Information Processing at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 6 or above
